/bin/sh -lc "cp /workspace/solution/method.py /workspace/solution/method_v62_test.py
cat > /tmp/patch_v62.py << 'PYEOF'
with open('/workspace/solution/method.py', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Update docstring
old_doc = '''\"\"\"Method v59: Signed log-ratio power modulation for BOTH up and down genes.

v39 baseline: Dev MSE = 0.001871, Score = 0.4882
v56 baseline: Dev MSE = 0.001607, Score = 0.5604
v59: Add RATIO_MOD_DOWN = 0.01 on top of v56 best (RATIO_MOD_UP=0.03)
  - Isolates effect of down-ratio modulation from up-ratio reduction
\"\"\"'''

new_doc = '''\"\"\"Method v62: Add DOWN_SHRINK_STRENGTH for down-gene disagreement shrinkage.

v39 baseline: Dev MSE = 0.001871, Score = 0.4882
v56 baseline: Dev MSE = 0.001607, Score = 0.5604
v59 best: RATIO_MOD_DOWN = 0.01 → Dev MSE = 0.001601, Score = 0.5621
v62: Add DOWN_SHRINK_STRENGTH = 0.3 (cross-ct disagreement shrinkage for down-genes)
  - UP_SHRINK_STRENGTH=0.5 works well for up-genes
  - Testing if similar logic helps down-genes
\"\"\"'''

content = content.replace(old_doc, new_doc)

# Change DOWN_SHRINK_STRENGTH
content = content.replace('DOWN_SHRINK_STRENGTH = 0.0', 'DOWN_SHRINK_STRENGTH = 0.3')

with open('/workspace/solution/method.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print(\"Patched v62\")
PYEOF
python3 /tmp/patch_v62.py
grep -n \"SHRINK_STRENGTH\\|Method v62\" /workspace/solution/method.py | head -5"
